holder-quote: He never made it. A second player, Maun, a female Gnoll, snagged the ball. Joseph lashed out—
effect-quote: Dodged. And took the ball with her! It jumped Joseph’s foot. He sprinted after her, snagged it back. He was running in the clear now, as other players blocked Team B. He saw Ush coming from the side, but Joseph adjusted his body. They were going to vie for the ball and he was nearly ready to score.
